svg.title: Selected Projects
svg.desc: A terminal-style overview of five software projects.
svg.text: lakshit@github: ~/projects
$ ls ./projects --details
01. Sortify Desktop
A Windows desktop application that scans file contents and helps identify files beyond their names.
It suggests meaningful names and organizes files with review and undo controls before changes are applied.
Built to make large, messy folders easier to understand, rename, and manage with confidence.
02. FacilityFix
A campus facility issue reporting and management system designed to make maintenance easier to coordinate.
Students can report problems while coordinators review submissions, track progress, and manage resolutions.
It brings issue reporting and follow-up into one organized workflow for campus facilities.
03. Pustakalaya LMS
A local-first library management system built to support the everyday operations of a library.
It manages books, copies, members, circulation, reservations, fines, and library records in one place.
Built with Python and Flask, with a structured data model and a standalone desktop-friendly workflow.
04. Veylo
A habit-tracking application designed to help bring daily routines and personal goals into better focus.
It gives users a place to organize habits, plan their routines, and keep track of progress over time.
A simple, focused space for building consistency and making everyday progress easier to see.
05. SaBuddy
An Android social media content planner for organizing ideas and preparing content before it goes live.
It brings captions, scripts, a content calendar, and saved ideas together in one planning workspace.
It also supports optional Gemini assistance to help with the content creation process.
$ echo "built with curiosity"
